runtime_review.scope: pending-sell entry: selector-level transition, not a recovered function name
runtime_review.detail: Retained indexed bytes reanalyzed 2026-10-12; SHA-256 matches runtime_identity. Selector0x70c6cea8 decodes three full calldata words with runtime roles (positionId, units, minProceedsUsdg); its source name/canonical signature remains unresolved and is not added to the publisher ABI. Entry0x773 -> decoder0x4fbf -> body0x1600 acquires slot8 lock, requires nonzero stored trader == CALLER, state2, underSince==0 and nonzero minProceedsUsdg. Helper0x41e1 converts requested units to shares: zero units or units >= current position units selects all shares; otherwise floor(positionShares*units/currentUnits), rejecting a zero rounded result. At0x16d2 SSTORE writes (oldWord & ~(0xff<<160)) | (3<<160) to keccak256(abi.encode(id,4))+1. At0x16ef writes sharesPending (base+8 low128),0x1719 writes minProceedsUsdg (base+7 high128),0x1739 writes lastTouch (base+2 low64). Minimum must fit uint128, checked after the first writes; failure reverts all writes. Token balanceOf STATICCALL dependencies and checked arithmetic must succeed through event emission before STOP0x496. This establishes a conditional state2 -> state3 path, not merely a UI label, and not a live position observation.

A bounded local opcode interpreter executed the recovered Desk dispatcher from PC0 with synthetic state only: id1, trader0x1111, token0x2222, state2, underSince0, position/listing shares2000000, simulated balanceOf2999, timestamp100000; calldata selector0x70c6cea8 plus words(1,100,50). It reached STOP0x496 in1009 opcodes, state3, sharesPending100000, minProceeds50, lastTouch100000, lock0; two successful simulated balanceOf calls, no DELEGATECALL. Also observed zero units selecting all shares, nonzero requests >= units capped to all shares, and borrower selector0x316e13a3 returning state3 -> state2. Wrong caller, state3 input, active checkpoint, zero minimum, uint128 minimum overflow, zero rounded shares and failed balanceOf reverted in the exercised branches. This is research evidence from a custom interpreter without gas/fork validation or a consensus-client cross-check; dependencies were simulated, no RPC/wallet/transaction occurred, and constructor-to-live-position reachability or all-path correctness is not claimed.

runtime_review.scope: adjacent pending-sell dispatcher and library boundaries
runtime_review.detail: Unnamed selector0x316e13a3 decodes an id, requires borrower/state3, writes state2 at0x11be and clears sharesPending/minProceeds at0x11d0/0x11e1. Unnamed selector0xa99c38af body0x23c6 requires state3 and no underSince, takes capped pending shares/stored proceeds and reaches shared settlement0x3e0d; borrower/nonborrower floor/route predicates remain distinct. Published closeNow selector0x8c778fa1 body0x1ea3 accepts states2/3; it is not the pending-sell creator. Shared settlement pins SettleLib0x39Ce3cf58d65c96c86803556e4091F735efDaB17 and selector0x0a48f8df, DELEGATECALL0x3e96. Retained SettleLib SHA-256 a484f98a1ed21f3c57a0dae8573b16834a583134a1a04998318a982fa33dbf3f has a reset-to-state2 write at0x2106 and pending-field clears0x2121/0x2131. These support the lifecycle but are not an exhaustive settlement/library storage-alias proof. No library call is needed by the traced state3 creator.

unitsOf is zero for zero shares or listing totalShares, otherwise floor(shares*(balanceOf(desk)+1)/(totalShares+1e6)); debtUsdg delegates scaled-debt conversion, zero before funded buy. Entry/reserved listing notional is not current marked exposure.
DELEGATECALL uses hardcoded SettleLib0x39Ce... and ListerLib0xA8Ad...; libraries operate on Desk storage. Neither publisher interface nor no-proxy metadata proves complete dependency safety.
